senses.gloss:
प्रबन्ध् €9 P.
—1 To bind on, tie, fasten.
—2 To stop, suppress, check.
—3 To compose, put together, arrange.

प्रबद्ध p. p.
—1 Bound, tied, fastened.
—2 Stopped, obstructed, checked.
प्रबन्द्धृ m. An author.

—1 A bond, tie.
—2 Uninterruptedness, continuance, continuity, uninterrupted series or
 succession; विच्छेदमाप भुवि यस्तु कथाप्रबन्धः K. 239; क्रियाप्रबन्धादयमध्वराणाम्
 R. 6. 23, 3. 58; Māl. 6. 3.
—3 A continued or connected narrative or discourse; अनुज्झितार्थसंबन्धः
 प्रबन्धो दुरुदाहरः Śi. 2. 73.
—4 Any literary work or composition; प्रथितयशसां भासकविसौमिल्लकविमिश्रादीनां
 प्रबन्धानतिक्रम्य M. 1; प्रत्यक्षरश्लेषमयप्रबन्ध &c. Vās.
—6 Arrangement, plan, scheme; as in कपटप्रबन्धः
—6 A commentary.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रबन्धार्थः, प्रबन्धकल्पना, प्रबन्धवर्षः
प्रबन्धः + -अर्थः the subject-matter of a composition or treatise.

प्रबन्धः + -कल्पना a feigned story, a work of imagination founded on a substratum
 of fact; प्रबन्धकल्पनां स्तोकसत्यां प्राज्ञाः कथां विदुः
प्रबन्धः + -वर्षः continuous or incessant rain.

—1 Bond, tie.
—2 Binding, fettering.
प्रबभ्रः An epithet of Indra.

प्रब(व)र्ह a. Most excellent, best; धृष्टद्युम्नः सोमकानां
 प्रबर्हः Mb. 1. 193. 1.

प्रबल a.
—1 Very stong or powerful, mighty, valorous (as a man); प्रणाशनाय
 प्रबलस्य विद्विषः R. 3. 60; Ṛs. 3. 23.
[]
—2 Violent, strong, intense, excessive, very great; प्रबलतमसामेवंप्रायाः
 शुभेषु हि वृत्तयः Ś. 7. 24; प्रबलपुरोवातया वृष्टपा M. 4. 2;
 प्रबलां वेदनाम् R. 8. 50; अबला यत्र प्रबला, बालो राजा, निरक्षरो
 मन्त्री Udb.; Śivamahimna 30.
—3 Important.
—4 Abounding with.
—5 Dangerous, destructive.

प्रबा(वा)लः, -लम्
—1 A sprout, shoot, new leaf; अपि … … प्रवालमासामनुबन्धि वीरुधाम्
 Ku. 5. 34, 1. 44, 3. 8; R. 6. 12, 13. 49.
—2 Coral; शुद्धं दृढं घनं वृत्तं स्निग्धं पात्रसुरङ्गकम् । समं
 गुरु सिराहीनं प्रबालं धारयेच्छुभम् ॥ Rājanighaṇṭu.
—3 The neck of the Indian lute.

प्रबा(वा)लः, -लम् + .{@-लः@}
—1 A pupil.
—2 An animal.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रबालाश्मन्तकः, प्रबालपद्मम्, प्रबालफलम्, प्रबालभस्मन्
प्रबल + .{@-लम्@} ind. Exceedingly, much.

प्रबा(वा)लः, -लम्
—1 A sprout, shoot, new leaf; अपि … … प्रवालमासामनुबन्धि वीरुधाम्
 Ku. 5. 34, 1. 44, 3. 8; R. 6. 12, 13. 49.
—2 Coral; शुद्धं दृढं घनं वृत्तं स्निग्धं पात्रसुरङ्गकम् । समं
 गुरु सिराहीनं प्रबालं धारयेच्छुभम् ॥ Rājanighaṇṭu.
—3 The neck of the Indian lute.

प्रबलता, -त्वम्
 Strength, power, might.

प्रबलता, -त्वम्
 Strength, power, might.
प्रबलति Den. P. To become strong.
प्रबली A class, division of a community (?); Inscrip.

प्रबाध् €1 Ā.
—1 To press hard upon, oppress.
—2 To trouble, torment, harass, tease, hurt; समुच्छ्रितानेव तरून प्रबाधते
 (प्रभञ्जनः) H. 1; Bk. 12. 2.
—3 To drive away, remove, get over; छायां ते दिनकरभाः प्रबाधमानं
 वर्षत्रं भरत करोतु मूर्ध्नि शीताम् Rām. 2. 107. 18; कथं च दैवं
 शक्येत पौरुषेण प्रबाधितुम् Mb.
—4 To throw down, destroy; समुच्छ्रितानेव तरून् प्रबाधते Pt. 1. 122.
—5 To repel, repulse.

प्रबाधक a.
—1 Repelling, repulsive.
—2 Harassing, oppressive.
—3 Keeping off or back.
—4 Refusing, rejecting.

—1 Oppressing, tormenting.
—2 Refusing, denying.
—3 Keeping off.

प्रबाधित a.
—1 Molested, troubled, oppressed.
—2 Pressed forward, driven onward.
प्रब(व)ह्लिका See प्रहेलिका.

प्रबालः + -अश्मन्तकः
—1 the red Aśmantaka tree.
—2 the coral tree.
प्रबालः + -पद्मम् a red lotus.
प्रबालः + -फलम् red sandal-wood.
प्रबालः + -भस्मन् n. calx of coral.
प्रबाहुः The fore-arm.

प्रबाहुक् ind.
—1 In an even line, to an equal height.
—2 At the same time.

प्रबाहुकम् ind.
—1 On high.
—2 At the same time.

प्रबुध् €4 Ā., €1 P.
—1 To awake, wake up, rise from sleep; प्रबुद्ध इव सुप्तम् Ś. 5. 11; Śi. 9. 30.
—2 To blow, expand, bloom, be blown; साभ्रेऽह्नीव स्थलकमलिनीं नप्रबुद्धां
 नसुप्ताम् Me. 94.
—3 To perceive, observe, be aware of. ━Caus.
—1 To awaken, waken, rouse; प्राबोधयन्नुषसि वाग्भिरुदारवाचः R. 5. 65, 6. 56.
—2 To acquaint with, inform, make known; तमभ्यनन्दत् प्रथमं प्रबोधितः R. 3. 68.
—3 To cause to expand or open; (पद्मानि) प्रबोधवत्यूर्ध्वमुखैर्मयूखैः Ku. 1. 16.
—4 To instruct, teach; explain.
—5 To persuade, induce.
—6 To stimulate, excite.

प्रबुद्ध p. p.
—1 Awakened, roused; तथा लिखितवान् प्रातः प्रबुद्धो बुधकौशिकः Rāmarakṣā 15.
—2 Wise, learned, clever; Pt. 1.
—3 Knowing, conversant with.
—4 Full-blown, expanded; पुष्पैः समं निपातिता रजनीप्रबुद्धैः Ve. 2. 7.
—5 Beginning to work or take effect (as a charm).
—6 Enlivened, lively.
प्रबुद्धता Intelligence, wisdom.
प्रबुधः A great sage.

—1 Awaking (fig. also), awakening; regaining oneʼs consciousness, consciousness;
 अप्रबोधाय सुष्वाप R. 12. 50; मोहादभूत् कष्टतरः प्रबोधः 14. 56.
—2 Blowing, expanding (of flowers)
—3 Wakefulness, sleeplessness; चिरप्रबोधान्न संभावितं धर्मासनमध्यासितुम् Ś. 6.
—4 Vigilance, watchfulness.
—5 Knowledge, understanding, wisdom, removal of delusion, real knowledge;
 as in प्रबोधचन्द्रोदय; सूतात्मजाः सवयसः प्रथितप्रबोधम् R. 5. 65.
—6 Consolation.
—7 Reviving the fragrance of a perfume.
—8 Explaining.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्रबोधोत्सवः

प्रबोधः + -उत्सवः N. of a festival observed from the tenth to the day of
 full-moon in the month of Kārtika.
प्रबोधकः A minstrel whose duty it is to wake the king, bard.

प्राबोध(धि)कः
—1 Dawn, day-break.
—2 A minstrel whose duty it is to wake the king in the morning by singing
 appropriate songs.

प्रबोधन a. (-नी f.)
 Awakening, rousing.

प्रबोधन + .{@-नम्@}
—1 Waking.
—2 Awakening, rousing.
—3 Regaining oneʼs consciousness; recovery of senses; प्रथमप्रमूढजनकप्रबोधनात् U. 6. 41.
—4 Knowledge, wisdom.
—5 Instructing, advising.
—6 Reviving the scent of a perfume.
—7 Refinement, enlightenment; Pt. 1.

प्रबोध(धि)नी The eleventh day of the bright half of Kārtika on
 which Viṣṇu awakes from his four monthsʼ sleep.

प्रबोध(धि)नी The eleventh day of the bright half of Kārtika on
 which Viṣṇu awakes from his four monthsʼ sleep.

प्रबोधित p. p.
—1 Awakened, roused.
—2 Instructed, informed, taught, acquainted with.
—3 Convinced, persuaded.

प्रब्रू €2 P.
—1 To proclaim, announce.
—2 To exclaim, shout.
—3 To say, speak, tell; पापाऽनुवासितं सीता रावणं प्राब्रवीद् वचः
 Bk. 8. 85; Pt. 1. 53.
—4 To praise, laud.
—5 To read before.
—6 To describe.
—7 To teach; प्रब्रूयाद् ब्राह्मणस्त्वेषाम् Ms. 10. 1.

—1 Ascendancy, superiority, predominance.
—2 Power, force, might.
—3 Validity (of a rule).
प्राबा(वा)लिकः A dealer in coral.

प्राबोध(धि)कः
—1 Dawn, day-break.
—2 A minstrel whose duty it is to wake the king in the morning by singing
 appropriate songs.
